summary: Frontend-only test of the waitlist benefits copy, the new Ready section and the SMS CTAs. Ran Playwright at 390px and 1366px. waitlist-benefits shows the 4 required items, and waitlist-success mentions cohort availability, trading tips, pop-up events/webinars and student shout-outs. ready-section comes right after waitlist-section (waitlist bottom == ready top) with the headline 'I'M READY TO SECURE MY SPOT TODAY.'. ready-phone shows (602) 804-8859, and ready-instructions lists full name, Instagram handle, READY, PAY UPFRONT or PAYMENT PLAN and the 24–48 hours note. ready-text-button and pricing-ready-button (inside pricing-block) both call window.open with sms:+16028048859?body=READY%0AFull%20name%3A%20%0AInstagram%3A%20%40%0APAY%20UPFRONT%20or%20PAYMENT%20PLAN%3A%20. No page errors, and the page URL did not change. Layout: stacked on mobile (no horizontal overflow, scrollWidth 390); two columns on desktop (button column x=103, instructions card x=682). Regression: the 390px waitlist submit succeeded, and the test lead was soft-deleted through the admin API (200; search now returns []).

issues: The 'I'M READY TO SECURE MY SPOT' label on pricing-ready-button wraps to two lines with letter-spacing ('SPOT' ends up on line 2), which looks cramped. Shorten the label or reduce the letter-spacing on narrow widths.

After submit, onSuccess scrolls to the top of waitlist-section. On mobile the heading and the 4 benefits fill the viewport, so the waitlist-success card is below the fold. Consider scrolling to the success card itself.
ready-phone is plain text and does nothing when tapped. Optionally make it tappable to open the same sms/tel link.

action_items: (Minor) Stop the pricing-ready-button label from wrapping at 390px.
(Minor) After a successful waitlist submit on mobile, scroll to the waitlist-success card.
(Optional) pricing-ready-button only renders when the payment plan is shown (plan.length). If the admin hides the payment plan, the pricing CTA disappears. Confirm this is intended.
critical_code_review_comments: Ready.tsx: openReadyText uses '&body=' on iOS and '?body=' elsewhere. That works, but recent iOS versions also accept '?body='. OK as is.
Ready.tsx: the Linking.openURL catch silently swallows the error. On desktop browsers with no SMS handler, nothing visible happens. The phone number is shown nearby, so this is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created one lead (test_ready_*@example.com) and soft-deleted it afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To verify the SMS CTAs on web, stub window.open via add_init_script; RN-web Linking.openURL calls window.open. ready-section comes after waitlist-section and is not in the index.tsx ORDER anchors. pricing-ready-button is inside the payment-plan card within pricing-block. Admin cleanup: POST localhost:8001/api/auth/login, then GET /api/admin/leads?search=..., then DELETE /api/admin/leads/{id}.
